facts.label: Name
facts.value: 熙春园 / 清华园 Xichun Yuan, Qinghua Yuan

facts.label: In English
facts.value: Garden of Bright Spring (Tsinghua's 工字厅)

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: held by 奕誴 (惇亲王 line, from 1846), named 清华园 by Xianfeng; spared in 1860 (S1219; S1206)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: osm way 659826161 (工字厅, historic=building) centroid; its extent, a circle of 200 m, is assumed

facts.label: Note
facts.value: 1707 for 诚亲王胤祉; a garden of 圆明园 under Qianlong (lead); 1822 the east part (涵德园) to 惇亲王绵恺. 清华学堂 opened in it 1911 (S02 pp.215-216: 'country seat of Prince Tun'). Survives: 工字厅, 古月堂. The historic=manor way 1369111544 (1.3 ha) is only the 工字厅 court.

sources.text: Carroll Brown Malone, History of the Peking Summer Palaces under the Ch'ing Dynasty, Illinois Studies in the Social Sciences XIX, Urbana 1934; reprint Paragon 1966
